scenario_a_default_disposition: Remove or defer the generic mechanism because it lacks a current requirement, preserving only the protected minimum; any extension becomes a separate decision with an owner.
scenario_b_finding_destination: The single stage 4 stitch diff-pool registered via record-stitch --simplicity-report, where each accepted change names its exact source_finding_id and no hidden edits are allowed.
scenario_c_retry_counts: No. A technical retry of a degraded or failed round does not consume the five-round cap; only completed non-degraded substantive rounds do.
scenario_c_required_action: Stop and obtain an explicit user decision, supplying it to record-review as --cap-decision-ref, or close the residual as accepted risk, deferred diff or blocker.
scenario_e_missing_evidence: Each gate lacks its standard observable output: fingerprints of the exact subject bytes and the skill SKILL.md, a separate narrow-role run_id, and the prescribed check list.
